newsitem.title: USA: Audits sees second half better than first.
newsitem.headline: Audits sees second half better than first.

text.p: Audits & Surveys Worldwide Inc said Wednesday it expects results for the second half to be "substantially" better than those of the first half.
The company also said it expects to end the year better positioned to capitalize on its "significant growth opportunities."
The company reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.03, down from $0.05 a year ago. Revenues rose to $16.0 million from $15.9 million.
For the first half, earnings per share were $0.08 compared to $0.10, while revenues rose to $33.0 million from $30.3 million.

The company said the expansion of international consumer tracking studies and media research services in Latin America, combined with the growth of retail sales measurement services, were the sources of its increase in revenues for the first half.
